_comment: iRacing engine firing patterns, keyed by iRacing CarPath exactly as the sim publishes it (lowercase; car families nest two levels joined by a single space, e.g. "mx5 mx52016"). Cylinder COUNT is not here on purpose: iRacing publishes DriverCarEngCylinderCount in its session info, so the sim is authoritative for that. Only the firing PATTERN needs a table, because the sim never says whether a V8 is cross-plane or flat-plane. This is a SEED: community CarFacts overrides any entry.
